routes.description: Yes. Wheel of Names draws the winner with your browser's cryptographic random source before the wheel moves, and you can check it with 10,000 draws.

toolSpecs.title: Wheel of Names spinner
toolSpecs.jtbd: Turns a pasted list into a canvas wheel of equal slices, draws one winner with crypto.getRandomValues and rejection sampling before any motion, spins 5-7 seconds to that slice, and shows the winner with its chance and the entries left.

typical.profile: a class roster or giveaway list of 3-40 names pasted one per line, usually copied out of a spreadsheet column

output.label: One winner on a draw slip
output.description: The tool panel [data-tool-output] wraps the input zone, the wheel and the slip. Inside it: a canvas wheel with one equal slice per line, an entries line reading 12 names (a repeated name is shown as A

expect.value: Add at least two names to spin

toolSpecs.privacyNote: Names stay in this browser tab; no entry text is sent anywhere. The winner is drawn with crypto.getRandomValues and rejection sampling before the wheel moves.

toolSpecs.title: Weighted picker wheel
toolSpecs.jtbd: Gives each pasted entry an integer weight from 1 to 10, shows each entry's percentage chance on the wheel, draws one winner in proportion to total weight with crypto.getRandomValues, and reports that chance on the result card.

inputs.label: Entries, one per line as name, weight

typical.profile: 10-40 entries pasted one per line, each optionally followed by a weight from 1 to 10 (name, weight); untouched lines stay at weight 1

output.label: Weighted wheel and one winner
output.description: Inside [data-tool-output]: slices sized by weight, each slice label repeating its percentage, an odds list where every row [data-entry] carries a number field 1-10, one filled primary control under th

expect.value: Weights are whole numbers from 1 to 10

toolSpecs.privacyNote: Entries, weights and the drawn result are handled on the device; the chance on the result card is worked out there too and nothing is sent anywhere.

toolSpecs.title: Ordered raffle draw
toolSpecs.jtbd: Draws a requested number of distinct winners one at a time from the pasted list, records each name with its draw order and time in a results table that copies as text, and stops when the winners reach the list size.

typical.profile: 30-2000 ticket numbers or names pasted one per line, leading zeros kept as typed

output.label: An ordered results table
output.description: The results table [data-results] holds one row [data-draw-row] per winner with the draw order, the entry exactly as pasted and the local time it was drawn, plus a Copy as text action. Above it a figur

toolSpecs.privacyNote: Ticket numbers and names stay in the browser; each winner is drawn with crypto.getRandomValues and rejection sampling and written into the local table only.

toolSpecs.title: 10,000-draw fairness check
toolSpecs.jtbd: Runs 10,000 draws on the current list inside the browser and reports each entry's observed count and share beside the expected 1-in-N share, with the largest deviation, without sending any entry text anywhere.

inputs.label: The list to test, one entry per line

typical.profile: the same 3-40 name list the visitor is drawing from on the wheel

output.label: An observed-versus-expected table
